name: check-memory
description: Destructive RAM test of all memory the kernel is not using, run by the hub chunk by chunk with parameter-patched EXEC probes (fixed patterns + inverse pass, address pattern). MMU is off, so every access hits DRAM uncached.
excluded: [0, 16 MB): kernel image, EXEC/persona/stage/resident buffers, stack (SP starts at 16 MB)
[0x02000000, 0x02400000): GENET RX/TX packet buffers (0x02000000/0x02100000) and the xHCI DMA region
above the mailbox 'ARM memory' end: GPU memory and the framebuffer
